title: 2-step ideals and commuting matrices
summary: 2-step ideals are ideals $I$ of the polynomial ring that satisfy $\mathfrak{m}^{k+2}\subsetneq I\subsetneq \mathfrak{m}^k$ where $\mathfrak{m}$ is the maximal ideal generated by variables. This class of ideals was recently introduced in [F. Giovenzana, L. Giovenzana, M. Graffeo, P. Lella: New components of Hilbert schemes of points and 2-step ideals, 2025, arxiv: 2507.02789] with the aim to obtain new irreducible components of $\mathrm{Hilb}^d(\mathbb{A}^n)$ and in particular to obtain new loci in $\mathrm{Hilb}^d(\mathbb{A}^3)$ of large dimension.
